assistant.title: Use the built-in AI assistant

steps.title: Open model services
steps.body: In the desktop app, go to Settings → AI Assistant, or choose Configure model in a chat. Under Model services, add a provider or edit an existing one.

steps.title: Choose and save your models
steps.body: Choose a provider such as OpenRouter or DeepSeek and enter its API key and endpoint. Choose Get available models, check the models you want, and save. To add one manually, choose Add model and enter its ID and display name.

steps.title: Send your first request
steps.body: Return to AI Assistant and select a model you enabled. Open an article you want to read and try this request.

assistant.example: “Summarize the three main points of this article as a list.”
assistant.noExamples: This provider has no models in this seven-model demo.

steps.title: Launch App & Install Skill

steps.title: Create Browser
steps.desc: Name the browser and open it directly; expand advanced options for customized settings.

steps.title: Call it from Claude Code / Codex and other Agents
steps.desc: Type /webcross-browser in Claude Code, Codex or any other AI agent — or just ask in plain language — and the agent drives the browser for you.

tips.title: Strictly Local-First
tips.desc: All cookies, credentials, and browsing history stay 100% on your personal machine and are never uploaded.

tips.title: Dedicated Prompt Rules
tips.desc: Define custom guidelines per browser; AI assistants read and obey them on every connection to prevent mistakes.

tips.title: Anti-Detect Isolation
tips.desc: Each browser maintains separate cookies, storage, and proxies, enabling safe multi-account management.

faq.title: **FAQ**
faq.subtitle: Common questions regarding setup, environments, and local privacy.

items.q: Why didn't my proxy or fingerprint changes take effect immediately?
a: To protect session consistency, proxy and fingerprint changes take effect after reopening the browser. Prompts update on the next connection.

items.q: Are my passwords and cookies uploaded anywhere?
a: Never. WebCross is built on a strict local-first architecture. All browsing data and session credentials stay on your machine.

items.q: Will the AI model ever get my account name and password?
a: No. Account names and passwords are entered and used directly in your local browser environment. The model only receives the information it needs — page structure, control state, and execution results — and never sees your plaintext credentials.

Cookies, sessions, and login credentials also stay entirely local. At sensitive steps such as CAPTCHAs, two-factor verification, or payment confirmation, you can switch to human takeover — your critical credentials never leave your device.

items.q: How do I configure WebCross for third-party AI agents?
a: WebCross prepares the webcross-browser Skill automatically when it starts. On first launch (or from the install dialog) you can install it into the Universal, Claude and Codex directories with one click — several agents can be selected at once, and existing files are backed up before updating.

Once installed, type / in Claude Code, Codex or any other Skills-aware agent and pick webcross-browser, or simply ask in plain language. If an already-running agent does not see the Skill, restart that agent once. No SDK integration and no manual file copying are required.

download.lead: WebCross runs on your computer, ready to handle complex web tasks after installation.
download.panelLead: Select a version for your system. Switch platforms anytime.
download.faqIntro: If you are checking your system or installation path, these short answers should help.

faq.question: Which systems are supported?
faq.answer: The current release supports macOS 13 or later and Windows 10 / 11 64-bit. Check the installer notes for final compatibility details.

faq.question: Which version should I download?
faq.answer: The page recommends a platform based on your browser's system. You can still choose the other platform; nothing downloads automatically.

faq.question: Do I need extra configuration?
faq.answer: Complete any permissions requested by your system, open WebCross, and enter your first natural-language task in the workspace.
